Name: Minotaur
Overview:
Play as the Minotaur... Wandering the world with your axe, destroying everything that tries to harm you. Chop, smash, combo, block and counter your way through entire armies!

Play co-op with 3 friends locally, or up to 7 friends over Xbox Live.

Unravel the mystery of the mysterious falling rocks from the sky! Paint the ground with the blood of your fallen enemies!
